name: Sex DAO
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: The Web3 social platform Sex DAO is suspected to have been Rug. The original white paper has been deleted. Over 220,000 USDT and 4.17 billion SED (SEXDAO Token) have been transferred on the chain. Currently, the Sex DAO official website and official Twitter account are inaccessible.
